title: Amazing tour
text: What a beautiful day!! The views were amazing and our tour guide Marcel was extremely welcoming. We got to admire the history as well as the beautiful sceneries of Gerona & Costa Brava. We highly recommend the excursion with Marcel.
author: F6968RKemilieb

title: Great One day Tour out of Barcelona
text:
Girona City Tour with guide Fily was beyond my expectations. This beautiful old city has lot to offer as to the history buff visitor. Guide Fily was very knowledgeable and helpful. He took us to walking tour to see GoT HBO Show Episode shooting location, I was delighted to see the Cathedral and tower as I am GoT fan. Rambala Lliberated area visit to see nice river and cafes  lined with trees and flowers. 

On way to Costa Brava, stopped to see Village Medieval de Pals, beautiful old village with cobblestone streets and winding slope. 

Though it rained lightly when we reached Costa Brava Beach
author: Jasvant_S

title: A Must See Tour
text: A most enjoyable tour that shouldn’t be missed. Feliciano was an excellent guide explaining the history of the beautiful old city of Girona and the coast of Costa Brava.  Our daughter enjoyed the Game of Thrones filming location. Plenty of good seafood in Costa Brava.
author: Linda_B

title: Beautiful scenery, tons of history, and impressively knowledge guides!
text: This was an awesome trip! Feliciano was was one of the most knowledgeable tour guide I’ve ever had. He could answer questions about architecture, history, art, wine, food, sports, etc. He paid special attention to what each of our group members were interested in and went out of his way to point out things that we would like. The tour went from Girona, to Pals, to Costa Brava, so it was a really good mix of things to see. Girona was my favorite, as there was a lot of history and architecture that I really enjoyed, plus Feliciano was able to point out some filming locations for Game of Thrones.

title: Tour 100% Recommended to all types of people
text:
